fields.description: Lyvia by Palace is a branded residential address in Green Gate at Dubai Creek Harbour. Its collection combines one to three bedroom apartments with three bedroom townhouses. Emaar’s proposal places landscaped terraces, gardens and leisure facilities around the homes, connecting a quieter residential setting with the wider waterfront district.

overview: The brochure’s interior direction combines warm neutral colours, timber and marble with textured finishes. Garden spaces and terraces are part of the Palace-branded residential concept, while Green Gate’s park, plaza and sports landscape provide the broader neighbourhood setting. The apartments and townhouses offer different ways to use that setting: the latter have separate living levels and roof space rather than simply a larger apartment footprint. The brand association alone does not establish a hotel-service package, rental arrangement or membership benefit; these should be confirmed in the residence documents.
research.locationNote: Lyvia sits in Green Gate at Dubai Creek Harbour, within the wider waterfront district shown alongside Creek Beach, the marina and promenades. The brochure presents the Metro Blue Line as upcoming infrastructure. Its eventual access and opening should not be treated as an existing transport service.
research.priceNote: Emaar’s current selection begins at AED 2,684,888, while the page retains a from-AED-1.98m headline. The original fact sheet lists one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments from AED 1.98m, AED 2.92m and AED 4.12m, and three-bedroom townhouses from AED 6.76m. Launch figures are historical; request current unit-specific pricing.
research.paymentNote: The launch brief shows 10% booking, seven further 10% instalments and 20% at estimated completion. The later construction triggers are 50%, 70% and 90%. Early calendar instalments have passed; a current reservation may have different amounts already due.
research.handoverNote: July 2029 is the project brief’s estimated completion month, corroborated by Property Finder. Obtain the current developer programme and contractual delivery date.

facts.label: Launch collection
facts.value: 478 homes: 230 one-bedroom, 191 two-bedroom and 48 three-bedroom apartments, plus nine townhouses. This is the original mix, not available inventory.

facts.label: Townhouse layout
facts.value: The TH01–09 drawing shows three levels, a ground-floor bedroom and maid’s room, another living space upstairs and a roof lounge. The total comprises 2,337.06 sq ft suite and 901.05 sq ft balcony/terrace.

facts.label: Published size variation
facts.value: The fact sheet lists townhouses at 3,238–3,245 sq ft, while the reviewed shared plan gives 3,238.11 sq ft. Request the drawing for the exact unit rather than assuming the upper figure applies to every townhouse.
